response.sql: WITH site_groups AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.healtheval AS status, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS average_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM site_groups) SELECT g.site_code, g.status, g.average_ratio, g.scan_count, g.average_ratio - o.mean_ratio AS amount_above_mean FROM site_groups AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE g.average_ratio > o.mean_ratio ORDER BY amount_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Zero-minute scans have no defined GB-per-minute ratio and are skipped in the average; scan_count still counts them.
